# BED BUGS (HEMIPTERA)

Antimicrobial treatment is not indicated. Treat itching with topical corticosteroids or systemic antihistamines.

## Inpatient

Triamcinolone 0.1% cream apply to affected area BID PRN for itching ($)[M]

Hydroxyzine pamoate 25 mg PO TID until symptoms resolve, then take 25 mg PO TID PRN for itching ($) [H]

## Outpatient

Triamcinolone 0.1% cream apply to affected area BID PRN for itching ($)[M]
Non-VA order for above

Hydroxyzine pamoate 25 mg PO TID until symptoms resolve, then take 25 mg PO TID PRN for itching ($) [H]
